items.title: Waffle Brunch on a Heart-Shaped Board
items.alt: Three waffle quarters topped with berries sit on a heart-shaped wooden board beside a syrup jug and a plate of scrambled eggs.
items.description: A small berry bowl fills the board’s upper corner, while the separate egg plate balances its pointed lower edge.

items.title: Barbecue Slider Sharing Tray
items.alt: Two barbecue sliders share a red enamel tray with grilled corn, baked beans and shredded slaw.
items.description: Shiny round buns sit over shredded barbecue filling and pickle slices, with the side dishes arranged behind them on brown paper.

items.title: Crab and Shrimp Feast Platter
items.alt: A red crab and curled shrimp fill a blue oval platter with corn, baby potatoes and lemon wedges.
items.description: The large crab anchors the center, with its claws visible above the bright corn and mixed whole and halved potatoes.

items.title: Herb Flatbread with Salad and Hummus
items.alt: Herb-covered flatbread strips sit on a wooden paddle beside a chopped salad bowl and a patterned bowl of hummus.
items.description: The long handled board leads diagonally between the two blue-rimmed bowls, keeping the golden bread and fresh vegetables distinct.

items.title: Hummus and Vine-Leaf Sharing Tray
items.alt: A round brass tray holds hummus, pita triangles, olives, cucumber slices and stuffed vine-leaf rolls.
items.description: Small inset dishes surround the central hummus bowl, leaving the engraved gold rim visible around the meal.

items.title: Lasagna Supper with Bread and Salad
items.alt: A lifted lasagna portion rises from a blue baking dish beside garlic bread and a bowl of green salad.
items.description: Long cheese strands connect the square serving to the pan, while the complete wooden-handled spatula extends from its right side.
